title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
summary: An innkeeper with a hidden past tells the true story of his life: a gifted boy who loses his family, survives the streets and fights his way into a university of magic.
readIf: You love rich prose and a slow, detailed build-up to a legend.
skipIf: You need a finished series. The trilogy is still incomplete, and the pace is unhurried.

pairings.reason: A shorter, lighter fantasy with a similar storyteller's voice.
A different kind of epic, heavier on politics and ideas than on a single hero's story.
